run_compute_quality_metrics: run compute_quality_metrics to evaluate S2TT, S2ST, T2TT, T2ST, or ASR tasks from a TSV manifest
create_transcribe_series: create a pandas Series of transcriptions from audio file paths using a Whisper ASR model
test_compute_asr_bleu: test compute_asr_bleu to compute corpus-level BLEU between audio transcriptions and reference text
review_compute_asr_error_rate: review compute_asr_error_rate to compute WER or CER between hypothesis and reference text series
build_compute_corpus_metric_score: build corpus-level BLEU or chrF++ scores from hypothesis and reference text series with optional normalization
